p.src: 1  How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.

ja: しいことか。 丸みを帯びたあなたのももは
en: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.
u.src: 1  How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.

p.src: 2  Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.

ja: けることはない。 あなたの腰は、ゆりに囲まれた 小
en: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.

p.src: 3  Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.

en: Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.
u.src: 3  Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.

p.src: 4  Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.

ja: のそばにあるヘシュボンの
en: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.

p.src: 5  Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.

ja: はカルメルのようにそびえ、
en: Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.
u.src: 5  Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.

ja: しい人よ、喜びに満ちて、 なんと
しく、なんと心地よいことか。
en: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
u.src: 6  How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!

p.src: 7  This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.

en: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.

p.src: 9  Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep.

ja: のようだ。 愛する人のためになめらかに
en: Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep.

ja: のもの。 あの人の思いは

p.src: 11  Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.

en: Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.
u.src: 11  Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.

p.src: 12  Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.

ja: いたか、 ざくろが花を咲かせたか
en: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.

p.src: 13  The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.
